about: Concrete claims in the documents that can be checked against public sources. Run scripts/verify_facts.py. A claim marked stable=false describes a state at the time of writing, so a newer value is reported as DRIFT, not FAIL.

facts.claim: fabric-cicd 1.4.0 is published (and is the release the design targets)
the Fabric CLI (fab) package ms-fabric-cli 1.8.0 is published
semantic-link-labs 0.18.0 is published
semantic-link 0.14.3 is published
fabric-data-agent-sdk 0.1.33a0 (an alpha) is published
the local Power BI modeling MCP server is published on npm
the report authoring CLI the powerbi-report-cli skill installs is published on npm (open item 9)
upstream fabric-skills is version 0.3.20
the public skills repository ships no tests, docs or build directory, so how skills are validated is not public
the pinned SHA in the CI workflow is the commit of actions/checkout v7.0.1
a moved tag on tj-actions/changed-files leaked runner secrets (CVE-2025-30066)
Comment and Control is arXiv 2605.11229
GitHub Agentic Workflows (gh-aw) is a live, unarchived repository
the Power BI modeling MCP repository is live and unarchived
the local Fabric MCP server lives at microsoft/mcp servers/Fabric.Mcp.Server
variable libraries are consumed by pipelines, notebooks and other items, but not by semantic models or reports

all: workspace\s+Admin role assigned for hard/permanent deletion
facts.claim: Delete Item with hardDelete deletes permanently and needs the workspace Admin role
purging a soft-deleted item needs workspace write permission (the admin page says Admin; the two disagree)
deleted workspaces are retained 7 to 90 days and permanent deletion of a recoverable item is an admin action
an Azure Table batch is atomic within one partition, up to 100 entities and 4 MiB
an Entra identity allows 20 federated credentials, and standard credentials match exactly (the page also describes the wildcard option of flexible credentials)
GitHub verifies a bot's commit signature under stated conditions
rulesets offer restrict updates, signed commits and required status checks
gh-aw has merge-pull-request and create-issue safe outputs, so the factory pins a minimal set
in gh-aw only network: {} blocks all access, so the factory pins it
gh-aw has a firewall, an API proxy, an MCP gateway and a SafeOutputs stage
the latest fabric-cicd release does not have the flag that fails a deployment on a binding error, so the executor asserts the binding itself
the strict-binding flag exists on the main branch of fabric-cicd

all: Power BI items other than semantic models don.t yet support outbound access protection
You can.t create these items in workspaces with outbound access protection enabled
facts.claim: the overview page says Power BI items other than semantic models cannot be created in a workspace with outbound access protection
the availability matrix marks outbound access protection Preview for reports, semantic models and data agents, and unsupported for ontologies
repositories created after 2026-07-15 use an immutable OIDC subject that carries the owner and repository IDs
Learn's custom role for pausing and resuming a capacity lists read, write, suspend and resume

all: pay for soft-deleted data at the same rate as active data
facts.claim: OneLake keeps soft-deleted files for seven days and bills them at the active rate

all: re.?create deleted items by assigning a new item ID
facts.claim: Git operations re-create a deleted item under a new item ID, where a recycle-bin restore keeps it
the Git supported-items page lists data agents with no preview tag, and the ontology, reports and semantic models as preview
the gh-aw Gemini CLI engine is deprecated and the Copilot engine is the default

all: only users with bypass permissions can push to branches or tags
facts.claim: GitHub words Restrict updates as limiting who can push, which does not settle how an API merge is treated (N2)

all: a user with write access to the repository can add the pull request to the queue
facts.claim: any user with write access can add a PR that passed its required checks to a merge queue

all: Stop usage when budget limit is reached
ULBs always enforce a hard stop
facts.claim: an organization Copilot budget only alerts unless its stop setting is on, and a user-level budget always stops usage
an App can be the required source of a status check only with the statuses write permission, a recent check run and a pre-existing required check

all: involved in the operation support service principals
facts.claim: Update From Git supports service principals when every item involved in the operation does, and a stale head is a WorkspaceHeadMismatch error
flexible federated credentials add wildcard matching for applications and user-assigned managed identities, so exact matching is a choice of the design

all: 120 query requests per minute per user
facts.claim: executeQueries returns at most 100,000 rows or 1,000,000 values and allows 120 requests a minute per user
the firewall source holds per-invocation request and token ceilings in its experimental enclave path, which the stable gh-aw frontmatter does not expose
the experimental enclave settings agent.max-model-requests and agent.max-model-tokens are documented as advisory, not enforced ceilings

all: hard stop for unusually expensive runs
Cap Daily AI Credits per Workflow
facts.claim: gh-aw's max-ai-credits is documented as a hard stop for a run, one credit is one US cent, pricing is best-effort, and there is a daily cap per workflow
the stable gh-aw frontmatter has max-turns (default 500) and max-ai-credits (default 1000)
the firewall's API proxy has an absolute ceiling of 10,000 AI credits per run and answers later requests with an ai_credits_limit_exceeded error once the cap is reached

all: Draft pull requests cannot be merged
facts.claim: a draft pull request cannot be merged until it is marked ready, so a draft is a signal to people and the failed required check is the control

all: People with write permissions to a repository and pull request authors can change the stage of a pull request
No one can merge the pull request until you mark the pull request as ready
facts.claim: anyone with write permission can mark a draft pull request ready, and no one can merge it until it is marked ready

all: Converts a pull request to draft
Marks a pull request ready for review
facts.claim: the GitHub GraphQL API has mutations that convert a pull request to a draft and mark it ready for review

segment.start: Body parameters Name, Type, Description title string The title of the pull request.
segment.end: HTTP response status codes for "Update a pull request"

facts.claim: the REST call that updates a pull request takes no draft parameter, so converting a PR to a draft needs the GraphQL mutation

all: authored by the owner of the credential
does not support\s+specifying the author or committer
facts.claim: createCommitOnBranch authors the commit as the credential's owner, cannot set the author or committer, and signs it only 'if supported'

all: If a check and a commit status have the same name, both must pass when that name is required
Successful check statuses are success\s*,\s*skipped\s*,\s*and neutral
Checks from earlier commits don.t satisfy the requirement
facts.claim: a check and a commit status with the same name must both pass, success, skipped and neutral all count as passing, and only a check on the latest commit counts

all: An organization member was added to a team
activity relating to teams in an organization
A team was granted access to a repository
read-level access for the .{0,4}Members.{0,4} organization permission
facts.claim: a member added to a team arrives as a membership event, a team edited or given repository access arrives as a team event, and both need the Members organization permission

facts.regex: does \*\*not\*\* create a missing folder.{0,120}404 GitProviderResourceNotFound
facts.claim: the git-integration skill says git/connect does not create a missing directory and fails with a 404 GitProviderResourceNotFound, which the REST reference does not list
